scope: Complete explicit credentials, role-labelled numeric accounts and five/six-digit postcodes. Preserve explicitly labelled valid transaction dates and VND amounts. Credentials require colon/equals; quoted values can contain spaces/punctuation. No telemetry or production data collection.
baseline: Existing final 14 September runs on the same pre-change detector supply 238 old cases per runtime/configuration. New fresh 24 cases run before and after using isolated original source snapshot. Verify reused baseline hashes before reporting.
criteria: Unchanged meetsScreeningFloor. Inspect full, category-only and partial coverage losses and additional ordinary masking by case. Do not tune after fresh results. No model promotion or runtime migration implied.
limitations: Synthetic cases by the same developer, not independent real-world validation. All inference local; fetch blocked. Native and production-version WASM hosted in Node. No new latency or packaged-app claims.
